attribution.localizedCause: The residual topology is correct, but three source coordinates retain arithmetic information not present in the two separately rounded BF16 branch artifacts; the remaining boundary is conversion placement or branch precision at the live source residual join.

decision.rationale: Preserve the exact RMSNorm formula and direct residual, then replay the live join with the raw F32 normalization branch before its BF16 conversion and compare the complete population.

hypothesis.rationale: BF16 addition of the exact branch and direct artifacts matched 2,097,149 words but differed from the sealed source total at three coordinates, so artifact-level pre-rounded composition is not byte-exact.

transferableLessons: Exact component artifacts do not prove that the live join consumes those rounded representations; separately probing a branch can insert a conversion boundary absent from the original graph.
Three isolated mismatches are sufficient to block promotion of an exact codec update even when every other word matches.
uncertainties: Whether the source join consumes the raw F32 RMSNorm branch, a differently rounded direct branch, or another fused arithmetic form at the three boundary coordinates.

reasons: The complete 2,097,152-word composition ran twice from sealed teacher-free inputs, replayed identically, preserved a live negated control, used no forbidden dependency, passed resource guards, and validated its strict result receipt.
